metadata.title: Resolution of the Chairman of the Supreme Council of Health No. (32) of 2020 issuing the Regulation on the registration, pricing and advertising of medicines and pharmaceutical preparations
metadata.edition: Signed 27 July 2020, Official Gazette No. 3484 of 13 August 2020, in force the day after publication · arts. 1-25; no pharmacovigilance provision (listed by NHRA as Decree No. (32) of 2020)
metadata.legal_basis: Supreme Council of Health resolution; the Official Gazette text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
